The MySQL backend and client have been updated to use the non-deprecated `database` and `password` keyword arguments instead of `db` and `passwd`:

- In [`DatabaseWrapper.get_connection_params()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4vv_krbs/django/db/backends/mysql/base.py#L194-L229), replaced `kwargs['db']` and `kwargs['passwd']` with `kwargs['database']` and `kwargs['password']`.
- In [`DatabaseClient.settings_to_cmd_args_env()`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-4vv_krbs/django/db/backends/mysql/client.py#L8-L59), added support for the `'database'` key in `OPTIONS` (falling back to `'db'` and `NAME`).
